change: Serialize immutable lowering context once and preserve ordered per-job interface positions
protocol: Merged retained-parent baseline a vs immutable shared-context b; N3 alternating TaskGroup2 cold/warm pairs on one frozen merged-main corpus. Each pair has isolated guest parsed-source cache; checked-module, codegen-body and artifact caches off. Native JIT primed. Process-tree RSS sampled every25ms (shared mappings may be counted twice). No concurrent builds/tests/edits. Additional N3 fresh candidate serial-split and baseline ordinary-whole controls. Output Wasm hashes agree across old/new TaskGroup and serial split. Ordinary whole outputs are separately consistent and differ from split outputs. Worker phase includes parent encoding/decoding/merge; context serialization occurs once in b.

baseline_before_edits.scope: Pre-change baseline, N3 alternating old(a)/new(b via c snapshot) TaskGroup2. Serial controls are retained separately from the prior 48-sample experiment. Same frozen corpus; isolated guest parsed-source cache per cold/warm pair, native JIT cache primed, all other guest caches off. Process-tree RSS summed every25ms (shared pages can be counted twice). No concurrent builds/tests/edits. Service worker_ms now includes parent encode/decode/merge; do not compare this phase directly to old worker_ms.

validation.public_cli: 67 modules; workers1/2/4 exact serial output parity; bounded waves; context/input/source mutations refused; protected publication

limitations: Summed process-tree RSS samples every25ms may count shared mappings twice; it is not allocation volume.
Shared context decode happens once per worker instance, and workers restart each wave.
TaskGroup2 remains slower than serial split and ordinary whole; do not enable it by default.
Source reads, parent preparation, global passes and final codegen remain serial.
